photography.goldenHourNotes: Cape Town's light is extraordinary — clear Atlantic air means golden hour lasts 45 minutes and the mountains cast dramatic shadows across the city bowl. The Southeaster (Cape Doctor) wind can blow strongly in summer afternoons but usually dies at sunset.

weather.seasonality: Mediterranean climate — dry hot summers (Nov–Mar) and wet mild winters (Jun–Aug). Peak season is December–January. Spring (Sep–Oct) is beautiful and less crowded.
weather.summary: Mediterranean climate with hot dry summers. Winter brings rain but rarely cold. Excellent year-round destination.
